integrity: Exact proof with executed independent numerical cross-checks; originality is relative to inspected sources, not independent priority certification.
scientific_limitations: Exact orthographic Haar average for the standard regular cuboctahedron only; zero-measure nongeneric directions excluded; the unweighted silhouette probability is already implied by classical dihedral-angle expectation and is not asserted to be independently new; complete area CDF, deformations, finite-sample bounds, and historical priority remain unproved. Proof is analytical; accompanying finite experiments are corroboration.
title: Exact area-weighted silhouette law of the regular cuboctahedron
